text:
N'utilise pas Claude Code sans ces 5 plugins.
1. OmniRoute — il connecte Claude Code à plus de 200 fournisseurs d'API. Quand ta limite tombe, il bascule tout seul sur le modèle suivant. La session ne s'arrête plus.
2. Claude Mem — la mémoire d'une session à l'autre. Il retient tes projets et tes fichiers, tu ne réexpliques plus rien.
3. Headroom — il se place entre toi et le modèle et ne laisse passer que ce qui compte. Même résultat, beaucoup moins de tokens consommés.
4. Claude Code Setup — le seul officiel Anthropic de la liste. Il scanne ton projet et te recommande les hooks, skills, sous-agents et serveurs MCP qui lui correspondent. Et il enlève le reste.
5. Task Observer — il regarde comment tu travailles, apprend ta façon de faire, et améliore tes autres skills en arrière-plan.
Celui que personne n'installe, c'est le troisième. C'est pourtant celui qui change le plus de choses au quotidien.
Commente ce que tu veux, je t'envoie le lien des 5 en DM.

text:
I uploaded my resume to Claude and rebuilt it for the exact role, tuned my LinkedIn to match, then let Claude go find the jobs for me \ud83d\udc40

Most people send the same generic resume everywhere and wonder why it goes quiet. The resume is not the problem. Nobody tailored it to the job, the system reading it, or the recruiter searching for it. Claude does all three.

The 7 prompts:

1. Act as an ATS recruiter. Flags the missing keywords and filters that reject you before a human sees it.

2. Tailor my resume to the role. Rewrites it to match the job description without inventing experience, keeps it ATS friendly.

3. Improve my bullet points. Strong action verbs and measurable results instead of vague responsibilities.

4. Find my weak points. Acts as a hiring manager and gives you 10 reasons your resume gets rejected, plus the fix for each.

5. Write a personalised cover letter. One page, specific to the company instead of generic.

6. Prepare me for the interview. The 20 most likely questions with strong sample answers and follow ups.

7. Optimise my LinkedIn profile. Rewrites your headline and About section around the keywords recruiters search for.

Bonus: let Claude find the jobs for you. Using the Claude browser extension, describe your ideal role and have Claude search live job postings, pull the ones that fit, and hand you the shortlist.

AI will not get you hired on its own. But it presents your skills clearly, gets you past the ATS, and puts you in front of recruiters.

Save this before your next application.

#ai #claude #resume #jobsearch #careertips
